final: WITH g AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_gap FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gap) AS m FROM g) SELECT g.corpeventprx, g.avg_anlycount, g.avg_gap, g.avg_gap - o.m AS gap_minus_overall FROM g, o WHERE o.m IS NOT NULL
